scripts.setup: cp app/.env.example app/.env 2>/dev/null || true && cp server/.env.example server/.env 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.ci:test: node scripts/release/decision-engine.test.mjs && node scripts/release/pipeline-policy.test.mjs && node server/update-manifest.test.mjs
scripts.ci:build-sanity: cd app && npx expo config --type public > /tmp/cinelog-expo-config.json && cd .. && node --check server/index.js && node --check server/update-manifest.js
scripts.ci:validate: npm run ci:env-sanity && npm run ci:config-validate && npm run ci:lint && npm run ci:typecheck && npm run ci:test && npm run ci:build-sanity
scripts.secrets:encrypt: node scripts/secrets-crypto.mjs encrypt app/.env app/.env.enc && node scripts/secrets-crypto.mjs encrypt server/.env server/.env.enc
scripts.secrets:decrypt: node scripts/secrets-crypto.mjs decrypt app/.env.enc app/.env && node scripts/secrets-crypto.mjs decrypt server/.env.enc server/.env
scripts.dev: npm run ports:free && npm -w server run dev & npm -w app run start:lan & wait
scripts.app: npm run ports:free && npm -w app run start
scripts.app:tunnel: npm run ports:free && npm -w app run start:tunnel
